::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru silicon-IP firm licensing wireless, power-management and analog/mixed-signal IP plus standard digital interface IP.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Wireless and analog/mixed-signal IP, PMIC blocks and digital peripherals (AXI, I2C, QSPI, JTAG).
